title: 第17章 舞姬行刺初见未婚妻第18章 亲手拆了雪月楼
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
雪月楼内，依旧是那般纸醉金迷，靡靡之音不绝于耳。
中央的舞台之上，四位身姿曼妙的女子正翩翩起舞，她们便是雪月楼新来的四大头牌，一颦一笑，皆是风情，
每一个眼神，都带着勾魂夺魄的媚意，惹得台下的公子哥们阵阵喝彩，挥金如土。
“啧啧，这身段，这脸蛋，比我前世见过的那些国际超模还要顶啊！”
楚风端着酒杯，饶有兴致地看着，不由得感叹道：“这雪月楼，真是天上人间啊！”
“世子，这算什么！”
一旁的王胖子肥硕的身子凑了过来，挤眉弄眼地压低声音：“这四大舞姬虽然不错，但跟雪月楼的那位楼主比起来，那就是萤火与皓月之别了！”
“雪月楼楼主？”
楚风动作一顿，脑中闪过一个名号，“你是说那位雪月仙子？”
“没错！
就是雪月仙子！”
王胖子一提起这个名字，眼睛里都冒着光，满是憧憬：“那可是咱们大乾美人榜上常年前三的存在！
传说见过她真容的，魂都得被勾走！”
“可惜啊，她神龙见首不见尾，多少王公贵族砸下重金，想见一面都比登天还难！”
楚风的脑海中，瞬间浮现出原主记忆里关于这位雪月仙子的信息。
此女正是雪月楼的主人，传闻其姿容足以倾国倾城，是京城无数权贵子弟的梦中情人，就连楚风这具身体的原主也不例外。
可惜，无论是原主还是旁人，使尽了浑身解数，最终都吃了瘪，连其真容都没能瞧见。
久而久之，这雪月仙子，便成了京城中最为神秘的存在。
就在这时，舞台上的一名舞姬水袖一甩，身姿轻盈地飘然而下，莲步款款，竟是径直朝着楚风这一桌走来。
她身着一袭薄如蝉翼的轻纱，舞动间，玲珑有致的曲线若隐若现，空气中都弥漫开一股甜腻的幽香。

女子来到楚风面前，盈盈一拜，吐气如兰道：“楚世子，奴家红袖，不知可有幸，邀世子共度良宵？”
“我靠！
还得是世子您牛啊！
这美人竟然自己主动送上门了！”
王胖子看得眼睛都直了，口水差点没流下来，一张胖脸上写满了羡慕嫉妒。
楚风抬眼打量着眼前这位美艳的舞姬，嘴角扬起一抹玩味的笑意，他伸出手，在那舞姬挺翘的臀上不轻不重地拍了一下，触感惊人。
“美人相邀，本世子岂有拒绝之理。”
很快，两人便进了一间雅致的厢房。
房门刚关上，红袖便拉着楚风的手走向床边，不等他反应，一个旋身便将他扑倒在床。
“美人这么心急？”
楚风躺在床上，脸上挂着一丝邪魅的笑意。
“世子，接下来，就让奴家好好伺候您吧！”
红袖吐气如兰，声音媚到了骨子里。
她手中的水袖轻轻一扬，盖住了楚风的眼睛，而后者则是一副闭目享受的模样，似乎已经沉醉其中。
唰！
电光石火之间，红袖神情骤变，眼中杀机毕露。
她另一只藏在袖中的手，不知何时多了一柄闪烁着幽蓝光芒的匕首，以迅雷不及掩耳之势，直刺楚风的心口！
不过，预想中匕首入肉的声音并未响起。
那柄淬毒的匕首，在距离楚风胸膛仅有半寸的地方，被一只手稳稳地抓住了。
红袖瞳孔骤然一缩，脸上满是惊骇。

因为这只手的主人，正是闭着眼睛的楚风。
content_en:
Inside the Xueyue Tower, the atmosphere was still so ecstatic and the sounds of decadence could be heard endlessly.
On the central stage, four graceful women are dancing. They are the four new top names in Xueyue Tower. Every smile and every frown is full of charm.
Every look in her eyes was filled with seductive charm, causing the young men in the audience to cheer and spend money like water.
"Tsk tsk, this figure and this face are even prettier than those international supermodels I've seen in my previous life!"
Chu Feng held the wine glass and watched with interest. He couldn't help but sigh: "This Xueyue Tower is really heaven and earth!"
"Your Majesty, what is this?"
Fatty Wang on the side leaned over with his plump body, winking and lowering his voice: "Although these four great dancers are good, but compared with the owner of Xueyue Tower, they are the difference between Yinghuo and Haoyue!"
"The owner of Xueyue Tower?"
Chu Feng paused and a name flashed in his mind, "Are you talking about that Fairy Xueyue?"
"That's right!
It’s Fairy Xueyue! "
When Fatty Wang mentioned this name, his eyes shone with admiration: "Those are the top three on our list of beauties!
Legend has it that those who have seen her true appearance will have their souls taken away! "
"It's a pity that her dragon has never been seen. How many princes and nobles have spent a lot of money to meet her is even harder than reaching the sky!"
In Chu Feng's mind, the information about the Xueyue Fairy in the original owner's memory instantly appeared.
This woman is the owner of Xueyue Tower. It is said that her beauty is enough to captivate a country. She is the dream lover of countless powerful children in the capital, including the original owner of Chu Feng's body.
Unfortunately, no matter whether it was the original owner or others, they tried their best, but in the end they were all defeated, and they could not even see its true appearance.
Over time, Fairy Xue Yue became the most mysterious existence in the capital.
At this moment, a dancer on the stage flicked her sleeves and floated down lightly. She walked straight towards Chu Feng's table with smooth steps.
She was wearing a gauze as thin as cicada's wings. As she danced, her exquisite curves were looming, and a sweet fragrance filled the air.
The woman came to Chu Feng, bowed Yingying, and exhaled like a blue breath: "Chu Shizi, I wonder if I am lucky enough to invite the prince to spend a good night together?"
"Holy shit!
You have to be the crown prince, you are awesome!
This beauty actually took the initiative to deliver it to your door! "
Fatty Wang's eyes widened when he saw it, and he almost drooled. His fat face was filled with envy and jealousy.
Chu Feng raised his eyes and looked at the beautiful dancer in front of him, with a playful smile on his lips. He stretched out his hand and patted the dancer's pert buttocks gently, and the touch was amazing.
"When a beauty invites you, how can I refuse?"
Soon, the two of them entered an elegant side room.
As soon as the door closed, Hongxiu took Chu Feng's hand and walked to the bed. Without waiting for his reaction, she turned around and threw him down on the bed.
"Is the beauty so impatient?"
Chu Feng was lying on the bed with a wicked smile on his face.
"Your Majesty, let me serve you well from now on!"
Hongxiu exhaled like blue, and her voice was charming to the core.
The water sleeve in her hand raised slightly, covering Chu Feng's eyes, while the latter looked like he was enjoying it with his eyes closed, as if he was already intoxicated.
Uh-huh!
In the flash of lightning, Hongxiu's expression suddenly changed, and murderous intent was revealed in his eyes.
Her other hand hidden in her sleeve had a dagger shining with blue light at some point, and it pierced Chu Feng's heart with lightning speed!
However, the expected sound of the dagger entering flesh did not sound.
The poison-quenched dagger was firmly grasped by one hand only half an inch away from Chu Feng's chest.
Hongxiu's pupils suddenly shrank, and his face was full of horror.
Because the owner of this hand is Chu Feng with his eyes closed.
